runbooks.title: General HTTP 5xx investigation checklist
runbooks.content: 1. Find the first error in the logs and note the time. 2. Check recent deploys of the affected service near that time. 3. Check dependencies (database, payment gateway, cache). 4. Compare error rate before and after the change.

runbooks.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
runbooks.content: Symptoms: 'Connection is not available, request timed out' from HikariPool, intermittent 500 under load, waiting threads growing. Checks: compare maximumPoolSize with expected concurrency, look for recent config changes to pool settings, look for slow queries holding connections. Mitigation: restore previous pool size via config rollback.

runbooks.title: Payment gateway latency
runbooks.content: Symptoms: slow response from payment gateway, latency_ms above 1500. Usually causes slow checkouts but not HTTP 500. Check the gateway status page and retry configuration.

ground_truth.root_cause: Deploy 2.14.0 reduced hikari maximumPoolSize from 50 to 5, so the database connection pool is exhausted under load
